claims.statement: For an exact-rank-three O3 partition into one spectral-rank-one bank H with frame lambda vv^T and two exact-rank-two banks G1,G2, writing d_j for the determinant of the v-perp compression of the jth bank, D_j=|det M| lambda d_j and mu for the full one-from-each-bank principal-triple packet, one has D_1+D_2+mu=|det M| lambda.
If D_1<mu/4 and D_2<mu/4, then m=mu/(|det M|lambda)>2/3; if r,s are the eigenvalues of the first transverse compression, then |r-s|>1/sqrt(3).

If additionally mu>=1/512, lambda>=1/64 and max(D_1,D_2)>=mu/4, then the quadratic-form output has an essentially bounded density with norm <2805. The small-Rayleigh side alone is <1644 without the lambda lower bound.

secondary_unpaid_branch: small rank-one mass lambda<1/64 with non-small Rayleigh on each available grouped-determinant exit
